android.desc:
Get the must-have mobile app for every MAN truck and bus owner or driver. Our app halves your stop time by quickly diagnosing vehicle issues, whether they're big or small. You'll always know the seriousness of the problem, so you can act fast.

Our app supports all MAN trucks and buses with digital dashboard, including MAN TGA, MAN TGX, MAN TGM, MAN TGL, and MAN TGS fault codes. Please note that the app doesn't support MAN ships.

You can use the app offline after installing it, with access to over 20,000 error codes in the database. Just search for the code or error, and the app will give you the exact meaning and definition.

If you can't find your error code in the database, you can send us a message, and we'll find a solution for you. Our customer support includes service (LKW Service), and you can even send us a photo of your dashboard, and we'll reply as soon as possible.

When you buy the app, you get unlimited use and access to all updates, with no additional or hidden costs. Plus, we offer the app in 23 languages, including Serbian, English, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, German, Greek, Spanish, Finnish, French, Croatian, Hungarian, Italian, Korean, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovenian, Swedish, Turkish, and Chinese.

If you're a service technician, you can even contact us for a trial version of the application on your computer. Download our app now and get the support you need to keep your MAN truck or bus running smoothly.

Database updated: 18.05.2025.
